g.text: Probabilistic sensitivity analysis: Module C effects drawn from their SEs (independent event times; perfect correlation gives $50.3M to
$347.3M), gross cost, rebate, prior authorization multiplier and years 3-5 scenario drawn from their ranges. 1 million enrollees.
Across 10,000 draws the five-year net budget impact has a median of $145.4M (90% interval
Source: Module C estimates (CMS State Drug Utilization Data, Medicaid enrollment); SDUD gross reimbursement; statutory rebate floor 42 U.S.C. 1396r-8;
White House fact sheet Nov 2025. SDUD amounts are gross of rebates; rebates, prior authorization and years 3-5 are assumptions.
